Enroll now for Data Analytics Courses in Pune . 3RI Technologies Data Analytics Courses in Pune | Course Outline of 3RI Data Science Course in Pune Learning data science involves learning various aspects that constitute the gamut of data analyzing and processing. It requires an individual to develop essential mathematical expertise, business acumen, and technological skills to be a successful data scientist. 3RI Technologies touch every corner of the technology, ensuring that aspirants pursuing this course step out as thorough data professionals. Fundamentally requiring an understanding of any programming language, database (SQL), and applications like MS-Excel, CSV, along with a basic understanding of high school Geometry and Algebra, this course encompasses learning mathematics fundamentals, R programming, Python programming, and machine learning with Python. Here are brief outlining insights on each of the subject matter. Mathematics Fundamentals : Basics of statistics, introduction to statistics, probability, and probability distributions. R Programming : R programming, and descriptive and inferential statistics Python Programming : Introduction to Python, Python core objects, and functions. Machine Learning with Python : This involves learning various concepts and data science applications such as Pandas, Numpy, Logistic regression, ARIMA models, correlation coefficient, and naïve bays algorithm, multiple linear regressions, time series analysis, etc. Further, it also includes learning unsupervised learning algorithms, neural networks, and natural language processing.
